title: Notes · Isogeny Labs
description: Explanations of elliptic curves, the elliptic-curve discrete logarithm problem, the attacks on it, isogenies, and lattices, with worked examples computed by the code that builds this site.
heading: Notes
standfirst: Longer explanations of the mathematics under the cryptanalysis reference. The worked examples run on groups small enough to follow by hand. They are computed by the code that builds this site, and every number on them is checked again each time it is built.

groups.label: Elliptic curves
groups.intro: What an elliptic curve is, why its points form a group, and why recovering a secret multiple of a point is hard enough to build cryptography on.

groups.label: Lattices
groups.intro: The mathematics under ML-KEM and ML-DSA: lattices, short vectors, learning with errors, and the reduction algorithms used to attack them.

groups.label: Worked examples
groups.intro: Attacks run end to end on small instances, with every intermediate value shown. At these sizes the point is the mechanism, not the speed; each page says what changes at cryptographic sizes.

groups.label: Explainers
groups.intro: Longer pieces that compare approaches rather than walking through one.
